lines.en: Joint moves, making a soft noise.
Chews on old bones, making a soft sound.
Crawls forward, emitting faint light.
Body twists, scattering bone scraps.

lines.zh: 在地面上爬行，骨块摩擦。
lines.en: Crawls on the ground, bones scraping against each other.
Eats bones, making hissing sounds.
Moves slowly, bone chains rubbing together.
Bites bones, swallowing slowly.

lines.zh: 沿着骸骨蠕动，发出微光。
lines.en: Crawls along bones, emitting faint light.

lines.zh: 爬过破碎的骨头，沙沙作响。
lines.en: Crawls over broken bones, making a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 我只有几节骨头，走得慢。
lines.en: I have only a few bone segments; I move slowly.
My larva body is soft; my bones are not.
I circle the broken eggshell.
Each crawl sheds a little bone dust.
I inch toward the flesh plains.

lines.zh: 骨荒原上，我是一条小缝。
lines.en: On the bone wastes, I am a small seam.
Stays still, bones glow faintly.

lines.zh: 微光闪烁，骨壳微微震动。
lines.en: Faint light flickers, bones vibrate slightly.

lines.zh: 骨壳内静静躺着，等待孵化。
lines.en: Bones lie quietly, waiting to hatch.

lines.zh: 骨壳闪烁微光，耐心等待。
lines.en: Bones emit faint light, patiently waiting.
Sits quietly, bone chains gently swinging.

lines.zh: 微光下，骨壳静静地闪烁。
lines.en: Bones glow faintly in the light.
Bones wait silently in the shell.
Bones emit faint light.

lines.zh: 静静孵化，等待破壳而出。
lines.en: Hatches quietly, waiting to break free.
Glows faintly in the darkness.
I wait for you to smash that egg.
Inside the shell I listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家，骨壳微微震动。
lines.en: Detects player, bones vibrate slightly.

lines.zh: 发现玩家，骨壳微微闪烁。
lines.en: Finds player, bones emit faint light.

lines.zh: 盯上玩家，骨壳发出光芒。
lines.en: Fixes on player, bones emit light.

lines.zh: 玩家出现，骨壳轻微震动。
lines.en: Player appears, bones vibrate slightly.

lines.zh: 注意玩家，骨壳微微发光。
lines.en: Player noticed, bones emit light.
Focuses on player, bones flicker.

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，骨壳发光。
lines.en: Locks onto player, bones emit light.

lines.zh: 观察玩家，骨壳微微闪烁。
lines.en: Observes player, bones emit faint light.

lines.zh: 目光落在玩家身上，骨壳微亮。
lines.en: Focuses on player, bones emit a faint glow.

lines.zh: 盯住玩家，骨壳发出光芒。
lines.en: Fixes on player, bones emit light.
Have you got a bone in your hand?
Your boots are softer than bone.
You crouch and I lift my head.
Will you hatch me or crush me?

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块会动的骨。
lines.en: I see you as a walking piece of bone.
Ouch, that hurts.
I can't take it.

lines.zh: 卵壳外面太冷，我想回去。
lines.en: It is cold outside the eggshell. I want back.

lines.zh: 我的骨头还没长硬，就断了。
lines.en: My bones were not hard yet, and they broke.

lines.zh: 我的腿卡在碎石缝里了。
lines.en: My leg is stuck in a rubble crack.
That's painful.
I can't take it anymore.
Poor me.
Please help me.
A joint slipped; I can barely crawl.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉渣，我能闻到。
lines.en: I can smell the meat scraps in your hand.

lines.zh: 那点碎肉，够我长一节骨头。
lines.en: That bit of meat will grow me one bone segment.
Be careful, my exoskeleton is tough.
Hatch me, and you’ll get more.

lines.zh: 我的存在证明了骨之力量。
lines.en: My existence proves the power of bone.
Try my meat, it’s special.
Can you tame me too?
My voice has power.
You’d better not move me.
Keep your hand away from me.

lines.zh: 把我养大，我会替你咬人。
lines.en: Raise me and I will bite for you.
The egg must break before I am born.

lines.zh: 我的小甲壳被你撞得打滑。
lines.en: Your bump makes my little shell slide.
Be careful, I’m fragile.
Don’t touch me, I’m fragile.
Be careful, I’ll shatter!

lines.zh: 你踢开了我藏身的骨片。
lines.en: You kicked away the bone shard I hide under.
My shell is thin, be gentle.
I’m easily broken, don’t be forceful.

lines.zh: 你有没有意识到我在碎？
lines.en: Did you realize I’m breaking?
Be careful, I’m easily damaged!
Don’t touch me, I’m so fragile.
Come mate with me.
I’m looking for a mate.
My voice is the call.
Let’s hatch together.
Mate with me to fulfill our mission.
I just crawled out of the egg.
Come, let’s begin.
My voice has magic.
Mate with me, create the future.

lines.zh: 蛋壳一碎，我就钻出来了。
lines.en: The shell cracked and out I came.
Crawling closer to you
You smell my presence
Shell cracks open
Crawling to your hand
You grabbed me
Desiring release
Beware, hatched
Shell cracking sound
I crawl into your palm.

lines.zh: 别捏，我的骨节还没长牢。
lines.en: Don't squeeze; my joints aren't set yet.
Feel your presence

lines.zh: 我从碎掉的卵壳里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a broken eggshell.
In my sight
Seeking host
I crawl out of a broken eggshell.
Feeling your warmth
Tracing your scent

lines.zh: 我从碎掉的卵里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a shattered egg.
Host identified

lines.zh: 你的气味像刚死的东西。
lines.en: You smell like something newly dead.
I want into the seams of your armor.
Your ankle is closest to me.
I cling to the smell of bone and follow it.
Shell cracks
Waiting to hatch
Hungry call
Hatching time

lines.zh: 我沿着骨头的味道爬过去。
lines.en: I crawl along the scent of bone.
I will hatch
Hatchling emerges
I clamp onto your bootlace.
I jump, though not very high.
One move from you and I cling on.
Up the trouser leg I climb.
I have been watching you since the eggshell.
The smell of bone buries yours.
Sssss, bite you with sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 从壳中跃出，撕裂你的皮肤！
lines.en: Leap from shell and tear your skin!

lines.zh: 咬断你的手，让你痛不欲生！
lines.en: Bite your hand until it hurts!

lines.zh: 发出尖叫，试图咬穿你的装甲！
lines.en: Scream and try to bite through your armor!

lines.zh: 用尖锐的嘴咬碎你的骨头！
lines.en: Use sharp mouth to crunch your bones!

lines.zh: 紧咬不放，让你无法动弹！
lines.en: Clamp on tight and immobilize you!
Hatch from egg, ready to attack!

lines.zh: 伸出利齿，试图刺穿你的身体！
lines.en: Extend sharp teeth to pierce you!

lines.zh: 用小触角缠绕，让你无法逃脱！
lines.en: Wrap small antennae around you!
I bite the moment the shell breaks.

lines.zh: 从破碎的卵中孵化而出！
lines.en: Hatch from broken egg!
Crawl out of the ground slowly!
Emerge from rotten bone!
Crawl out from abandoned mine!
Scamper around after hatching!
Hatch from decaying wood!
Drill out from broken bone!
Hatch from ancient ruins!
Hatch from abandoned temple!

lines.zh: 孵化自远古的秘密之地！
lines.en: Hatch from forgotten place!
The shell cracks and there I am.

lines.zh: 我是被敲碎的卵里剩下的。
lines.en: I am what was left in a shattered egg.
Fire bakes my bones brittle.

lines.zh: 幼虫摔在卵壳碎片上，疼。
lines.en: The larva lands on eggshell shards. It hurts.
Cold water.
Boom! I was blown up.

lines.zh: 箭钉住我，我在卵壳边挣扎。
lines.en: An arrow pins me; I struggle by the eggshell.
Magic hit me.

lines.zh: 没有腐肉，我的牙开始发软。
lines.en: Without carrion, my teeth go soft.
Fresh out of the shell, and struck by lightning.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有骨头可以啃。
lines.en: There are no bones to gnaw in the void.
